notes: Committed schema-reference registry. This file is NEVER used at runtime; the live registry path comes from the SEEING_THROUGH_DEEPFAKES_HASH_REGISTRY environment variable, an explicit constructor argument, or the default under data/hash_registry/ (gitignored). Each entry stores only a SHA-256 digest and small descriptive metadata — no image bytes, thumbnails, embeddings, or perceptual hashes are ever recorded. See src/genai_detection/hash_module/README.md for the closed schema.
